statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-118653 affects Echo IP-based RateLimiter middleware, which accepts spoofed client-IP headers. Docker Agent v1.160.0 (commit f5cb1d66d67e274c2ec7cd22726614d5fffe98e8) does not call Proxy, ProxyWithConfig, RateLimiter or RateLimiterWithConfig. Inspection of the rebuilt binary Go function table finds Echo BodyLimitWithConfig, CORSWithConfig and RequestLogger functions, but no Proxy or RateLimiter functions; the vulnerable middleware is not linked into the Docker Agent executable. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-246p-cpwv-v3jq

CVE-2026-118651 affects Echo Proxy middleware, which forwards a spoofed X-Real-IP header when no IPExtractor is configured. Docker Agent v1.160.0 (commit f5cb1d66d67e274c2ec7cd22726614d5fffe98e8) does not call Proxy, ProxyWithConfig, RateLimiter or RateLimiterWithConfig. Inspection of the rebuilt binary Go function table finds Echo BodyLimitWithConfig, CORSWithConfig and RequestLogger functions, but no Proxy or RateLimiter functions; the vulnerable middleware is not linked into the Docker Agent executable. Advisory: https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-99jh-6h7p-pp36

Fixed in github.com/labstack/echo/v4 v4.16.3 (https://github.com/labstack/echo/releases/tag/v4.16.3; advisory https://github.com/labstack/echo/security/advisories/GHSA-246p-cpwv-v3jq). In v4.16.3 Context.RealIP() returns the connection peer address when Echo#IPExtractor is unset instead of trusting client-supplied X-Forwarded-For and X-Real-IP headers, so rotating forwarded-IP values cannot create fresh default rate-limit buckets. The temporal CLI binary in this image embeds echo/v4 at v4.16.3 or a later release and does not contain the vulnerable pre-fix behavior.

Fixed in github.com/labstack/echo/v4 v4.16.3 (https://github.com/labstack/echo/releases/tag/v4.16.3; advisory https://github.com/labstack/echo/security/advisories/GHSA-99jh-6h7p-pp36). In v4.16.3 the Proxy middleware derives the upstream X-Real-IP header from Context.RealIP(), which uses the connection peer when Echo#IPExtractor is unset, so a client-supplied X-Real-IP is no longer forwarded. The temporal CLI binary in this image embeds echo/v4 at v4.16.3 or a later release and does not contain the vulnerable pre-fix behavior.

GHSA-246p-cpwv-v3jq lists github.com/labstack/echo/v4 as affected through 4.16.2, with no patched v4 release (fixed in echo/v5 5.1.0). The shipped Temporal UI server contains echo/v4 4.16.1. Assessment is pending until a patched v4 release is published.

github.com/labstack/echo/v4 is embedded in /usr/local/bin/docker-agent from the upstream docker-agent release binary installed by sbx-templates docker-agent kits. Docker Scout reports no fixed echo release for this CVE yet; remediation depends on a new upstream echo release and a docker-agent rebuild that includes it.
